name: Bristol
meta_description: Plan a beer lover's day in Bristol: harbourside pubs, Wapping Wharf taprooms, West Country cider and bookable tastings, tours and experiences.
intro_md:
Bristol drinks well, and it always has. This is the West Country, so cider gets equal billing with beer — try The Apple, a barge on Welsh Back devoted to it — while the city's breweries have quietly built one of the strongest independent scenes in Britain. Wiper and True, Moor Beer and Left Handed Giant all brew here, and Bristol Beer Factory has long been a fixture south of the river.

Start at the harbourside. King Street's cobbles hold the seventeenth-century Llandoger Trow, and a short walk brings you to Wapping Wharf, where the Cargo shipping containers house independent traders, restaurants and taprooms. St Nicholas Market, in the old city, is the spot for lunch — its Glass Arcade is packed with food stalls.

Don't miss:

- A pint at the Llandoger Trow on King Street
- Cargo at Wapping Wharf for taprooms and street food
- St Nicholas Market's Glass Arcade at lunchtime
- A proper West Country cider at The Apple

gyg_tours.title: Bristol: Wine and Cider Tour with Tastings
gyg_tours.summary: A guided visit to an organic vineyard and cider farm on the edge of Bristol, with walks through the vines and orchards. Includes tastings of natural wines and award-winning ciders paired with local cheese.
gyg_tours.description_md: This 1.5-hour guided tour explores natural winemaking and cider-making at an organic vineyard and cider farm near Bristol. Visitors meet the farm owners, walk the vineyard and orchards, and learn about small-batch, seasonal production methods. The experience includes tastings of the handcrafted wine and cider alongside a local cheese pairing.
highlights: Guided tour of organic vineyard and orchards
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Organic vineyard and cider farm near Bristol (Failand area); transport to the farm is included.

gyg_tours.title: Bristol: Local Craft Distillery's Gin Tasting Experience
gyg_tours.summary: A two-hour session at a small Bristol craft distillery, starting with a garnished gin and tonic before a guided tasting of five seasonal gins in the tasting room. Tonic water and mixers are provided.
gyg_tours.description_md: Step into the world of craft gin with a relaxed tasting experience in the heart of Bristol. You begin with a beautifully garnished gin and tonic on arrival, then settle into a cosy tasting room to learn about the distillery, the history of gin and how the spirits are made. Taste five of the best seasonal gins, all produced in the in-house distillery, each with its own distinctive style, and discover how the botanicals are selected and how the award-winning gins are distilled, infused and refined.
highlights: Welcome gin and tonic on arrival
Learn how the spirits are made
Relaxed tasting in a cosy room
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Meet in the downstairs bar in the Rummer Hotel, situated in St Nicholas Market.
